final: WITH g AS (SELECT COALESCE(brokrepstat,'(no status)') AS st, AVG(modelconf) AS a FROM compliancecase GROUP BY COALESCE(brokrepstat,'(no status)') HAVING AVG(modelconf) IS NOT NULL), o AS (SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS ov FROM compliancecase), q AS (SELECT g.st, g.a, o.ov FROM g, o WHERE o.ov IS NOT NULL AND g.a > o.ov) SELECT st AS brokrepstat, a AS avg_modelconf, a - ov AS above_overall_avg, a / (SELECT AVG(a) FROM q) AS ratio_to_qualifying_mean FROM q
